text_block_list.text:
As I was walking down the hallway,
I heard an awful lot of commotion...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hey hey! Care to take on my special riddle?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry.
I have training after this, so...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Howdy! How about a special riddle
with a guaranteed big surprise?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Sorry, Teacher called for me~

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Mmm... Yeah!
I feel like our eyes are meeting...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Nice timing,
Trainer-san!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Actually, a friend just shared
a fun riddle with me!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, do you think you can solve this riddle,
Trainer-san? Alright then, let's riddle!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of bread, what kind of bread
can you not eat? WHAAAT IS THIIIS?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yes! That's exactly right!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
You're amazing, Trainer!
I had no idea at all!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Mmm-... But why a frying pan, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Well, dat is fine! Whenever I listen to dis,
everyone gives me a big smile, after all!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yay! Totally, right? Alright,
I'll go ask more people! See you!
(Grrr—)

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, talking about bread
has made me hungry.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: We'll do the rest next time. See you!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, you fell for it!
The correct answer is a frying pan!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Don't vorry! I made ze same mistake
at first too... Ahaha!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Well, I don't really get why a frying pan is the answer, though.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ah... yes!
If I recall... it was "bread"!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Pan"... Ah!!
I see, so that's why it's a frying pan!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I feel so very refreshed!
As expected of Trainer-san! Very smart!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I gotta let everyone know about this right away!
Well then, see you!
